notes.title: 🎃Happy Halloween!🎃 You Must be 18 or Older to Enter is released !
notes.content:
[b]We're officially live on Steam with [i]You Must be 18 or Older to Enter[/i]! [/b]
From both of us at Seemingly Pointless, we wish you a festive fright on this, and all future, hallow's eves.

If you sense October scares aren't up to snuff... open up your PC, pop onto Steam, and perhaps give [i]You Must be 18 or Older[/i] a whirl. Spice it up by leaving your doors and windows are open. [spoiler]And headphones off of course. 👌 [/spoiler]


[img]http://www.justdeleteit.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/tease.gif[/img]

Happy hauntings!
- Seemingly Pointless
